name: Unbound Method assignment requires callable-kind validation

input.fixture_ref: Assign A.method(:f) to Closure<(Integer) -> Integer> and then bind the same Method to an A receiver.

applicability.reason: Unbound Methods are observable, but callable-kind annotations and binding validation are not implemented.

expect.status: The unbound Method is rejected as a Closure; only an explicit binding produces a BoundMethod.
